```artifact
{
  "Test Suite for U20_Embedded Controller Functional Requirements":
  [
    {
      "id": "TC-001",
      "title": "Meet commanded pressure within overshoot",
      "req_ids": ["RW-SW-63"],
      "kind": "positive",
      "preconditions": ["Controller in pressure fall phase"],
      "inputs": {"name": "Pressure command"},
      "steps": ["Apply command", "Measure pressure"],
      "expected": ["Pressure <= 0.8*PEEP-1 cmH2O"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-002",
      "title": "Meet commanded PEEP within tolerance",
      "req_ids": ["RW-SW-64"],
      "kind": "positive",
      "preconditions": ["Controller in stable phase"],
      "inputs": {"name": "PEEP command"},
      "steps": ["Apply command", "Measure PEEP"],
      "expected": ["PEEP within +-1 H2O + 10%"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-003",
      "title": "Achieve target FiO2 value",
      "req_ids": ["RW-SW-95"],
      "kind": "positive",
      "preconditions": ["Controller in stable phase"],
      "inputs": {"name": "FiO2 command"},
      "steps": ["Apply command", "Measure FiO2"],
      "expected": ["FiO2 <= 0.05"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-004",
      "title": "Report FiO2 prior to inhale",
      "req_ids": ["RW-SW-97"],
      "kind": "positive",
      "preconditions": ["Controller in stable phase"],
      "inputs": {"name": "FiO2 measurement"},
      "steps": ["Report FiO2", "Inhale limb check"],
      "expected": ["FiO2 reported before inhale"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-005",
      "title": "Achieve commanded values under varying air conditions",
      "req_ids": ["RW-SW-98"],
      "kind": "positive",
      "preconditions": ["Controller in stable phase", "Air conditions varied"],
      "inputs": {"name": "Air condition parameters"},
      "steps": ["Apply command", "Measure FiO2"],
      "expected": ["FiO2 within tolerance under varied air conditions"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-006",
      "title": "Assist/control with pressure controlled ventilation",
      "req_ids": ["RW-SW-153"],
      "kind": "positive",
      "preconditions": ["Controller in assist/control mode", "Patient inspiration detected"],
      "inputs": {"name": "Inspiration signal"},
      "steps": ["Detect inspiration", "Apply assist/control command"],
      "expected": ["Assist/control command applied"]
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-007",
      "title": "Safety measures against absurd commands",
      "req_ids": ["RW-SW-156"],
      "kind": "negative",
      "preconditions": ["Controller in any mode", "Corrupted data received"],
      "inputs": {"name": "Corrupted data"},
      "steps": ["Receive data", "Check data integrity"],
      "expected": ["No action on corrupted data"]
    }
  ]
}
```
